text:
Maya (CS): quick sync from Brightlane call this AM — they gave four concrete asks that are blocking a larger rollout and are tied to next renewal. summary below, TL;DR: medium-high renewal risk if we don’t land a pragmatic path out by end of Q.
Jon (CS): thanks — can you list asks + impact in order? i'll add to the CS <> PM triage board :clipboard:
Maya (CS): copying notes:
- onboarding API for bulk account/route provisioning (they have 200 routes to migrate; doing it manually is 3 FTE-weeks)
- per-route cost & latency breakdown in Console (they need to map cost to product lines for chargeback)
- default model selection per-route (they want to pin cheaper model for some routes)
- migration checklist + sample scripts (docs + a CSV import would help immediately)
Impact: currently 2 pilot teams live; they expect 50% more routes in 6 wks. if we can't reduce manual effort, they said renewal is at risk. Elliot confirmed they hinted at exploring alternatives.
Priya (PM): useful — can you paste any direct quotes / numbers from the call? also, any security or SSO asks? we need to scope effort vs. quick wins.
Maya (CS): quote: "we're losing one onboarding FTE every week to manual config—if you had a way to bulk create routes and set model defaults we'd accelerate by months." Security: standard SSO + SCIM already requested, but that's on the infra roadmap. immediate asks are product-facing.
Alex (Eng): for onboarding API — do we have an existing internal endpoint we can expose short-term? if not, i can sketch an API surface. rough estimate: 2 engineers, ~2 weeks for MVP (create/update routes, set model_id, CSV import).
Jon (CS): CSV import sounds like a pragmatic interim — customers can run it themselves. Pushing that as a quick win reduces churn risk faster.
Priya (PM): propose initial prioritization (for discussion):
- P1: Onboarding API / CSV import (reduce manual FTEs now) :fire:
- P2: Per-route cost & latency breakdown in Console (important for their billing mapping)
- P2: Default model per-route (config option in route UI)
- P3: Migration checklist + example scripts in docs (low dev, high impact)
Can Eng estimate effort for P2 items? we can split into quick telemetry + UI follow-up.
Alex (Eng): telemetry for per-route cost already exists in raw logs, we need a small aggregation job + UI. ballpark: 1 backend + 1 frontend, ~3 weeks to ship a minimal per-route dashboard. default-model per-route likely 1 week UI + small backend change if model mapping exists.
Elliot (AE): FYI, renewal conversation is in two weeks. if CS + PM can commit to a timeline, i can escalate on their side and get a signed Letter of Intent. they care a lot about timelines more than features.
Maya (CS): suggested next steps from call: 1) PM triage + prioritize P1 this week, 2) Eng to confirm dev owners and ETA, 3) CS to surface mitigation messaging + temporary CSV template to customer by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (PM): I'll add to roadmap board and propose owners. @Alex can you confirm by EOD if CSV import + minimal API MVP fits the 2-week window? if not, give a revised ETA.
Alex (Eng): i'll validate with the infra folks and post an ETA by 17:00. initial feeling: CSV import + simple create/update API is doable in ~2 weeks if we scope to MVP (no large validation, basic auth).
cs-bot: reminder — product triage sync in 1h. :bell:
Maya (CS): thanks team — i'll send the customer the interim CSV template and note we have a potential path. will update thread after PM sync. :handshake:
